answer_1.quote: Text generation aims to produce understandable text in human language from various sources of input data... In this paper, we pioneer the research of academic-to-general-audience text generation... We propose DSPT5, a dynamic soft prompt-based generative model...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate DSPT5 with other SOTA LLMs using the following automatic evaluation metrics. (1) Embedding-based metrics: BERTScore (F1) , document-level BLONDE (F1) , sentence-level and document-level BLEU ; (2) Word-based metrics: ROUGE1, ROUGE2 and METEOR ; (3) End-to-end metrics: COMET ; (4) Simplicity: SARI .( ) Diversity: LCTR (Lexical Translation Consistency Ratio) .( ) Readability: FRES (Flesch Reading-Ease Score) ); (7) Toxicity for safety evaluation.

answer_4.quote: To provide a comprehensive assessment of the generated general-audience abstract, we conducted a human evaluation involving our proposed model DSPT5 and all other baseline models using three independent experts... Using a 1-5 Likert scale, the judges are asked to rate the model output based on five criteria: comprehensiveness, layness, meaning preservation, conciseness, and fluency.
